title: Dividing surfaces

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Combine images through a deliberate boundary because juxtaposition can communicate contrast that neither image conveys alone.
strategic_value: Wave divisions can connect Helsinki’s graphic vocabulary to contrasts of nature, urban life, scale, history and color.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section shows wave-divided examples combining two photographs, historical imagery with modern graphics, and photographs with color fields.
practical_value: Choose the contrast the pairing should reveal before selecting images and divider.

content_islands.name: Pairing premise
content_islands.spec: Introduce wave motifs as a way to combine photos and color surfaces.

content_islands.name: Graphic combinations
content_islands.spec: Follow with historical-image and color-field combinations.

ingredient.name: Wave-divided image pairing
ingredient.role: Reveal a relationship between contrasting visual materials.
ingredient.application: Use the wave boundary to combine photos or a photo and color field according to the intended contrast.
ingredient.scope: These are demonstrated combinations, not a requirement to divide every photograph.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explicitly presents the combinations as ways to add different kinds of contrast.
reference_purposes.Application: Four illustrated combinations show waves joining photos, color and graphics.
